senses.definition: Little known or hard to make out, or to keep something from being seen or understood.
distractors: Recognised instantly by almost everyone who sees it.
Repeated so often that it has lost whatever meaning it started with.
So familiar that people stop noticing it is there at all.
A claim that is easy to state and impossible for anyone outside the company to check.
A system that is still running long after the team that built it moved on to other work.
